answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 2843 Country: INDIA Title: I want to know the importants between kaza namaz and sunat namaz. If want perform my kaza namaz before or after for every farz namaz, can I do so? Question: I want to know the importants between kaza namaz and sunat namaz. If want perform my kaza namaz before or after for every farz namaz, can I do so? Answer ID: 2843 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 97/94=J) There is no wrong in offering qaza salah (missed prayers) before and after obligatory salah , but it is necessary to avoid makrook timings. It is better to make up missed prayers instead of praying nafl salah (optional prayers), but forsaking sunnah salah without an excuse is a sin: والاشتغال بقضاء الفوائت اولی و اھم من النوافل الا سنن الفریضۃ وصلاۃ الضحی الخ ( الشامی: 2/536 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
